snippet.title: Crash 'N' Dance (Crash Bandicoot Fangame) - Vintage Trailer
snippet.description:
OUT NOW!
Newgrounds - https://www.newgrounds.com/portal/view/861819
Itch.io - https://fiercethebandit.itch.io/crash-n-dance

"Get ready to dance your jorts off in this brand new and N.Tense rhythm game set in the beloved Crash Bandicoot™ Universe!
Bust all kinds of moves across 6 familiar worlds by hitting the right key at the right time inside the rings - but watch out! don't let distractions throw you off balance!"
Itchio - https://fiercethebandit.itch.io/
Newgrounds - https://fiercetempest92.newgrounds.com/

Developer - FierceTheBandit - https://twitter.com/FierceCosmicArt
In-Game Soundtrack - Patstrikesback - https://twitter.com/PatStrikesBack
Cover Art by Kevin Fagaragan - https://twitter.com/KevinFagaragan
